## Use cases

The library lists 152 practical SI jobs for small teams, community organizations, the business side of solo and small law practices, the business side of small healthcare practices, real estate and property management, home-service contractors, and small accounting, tax and bookkeeping firms. They are illustrations of what is possible, not reports of client results. A person still approves anything that sends, pays, orders, or posts. The library also covers ecommerce operations, local or seasonal work, legal-practice administration, medical-practice administration, real-estate operations, home-services office work, and accounting-firm administration. Legal-practice pages are operations help only. SI does not give legal advice, and an attorney reviews anything client-facing. Medical-practice pages are operations help only. SI does not give medical advice or make clinical decisions, and a clinician or trained staff member reviews anything patient-facing. Real-estate pages are operations help only. SI prepares drafts for the licensed agent or owner and does not lease, collect rent, screen or rank applicants. Home-services pages are office help only; the owner approves every quote and message. Accounting-firm pages are operations help only. SI does not give tax advice or file returns, and a professional reviews, signs and decides. GemmiSI sets this up on your own equipment and accounts; your data stays with you.

## Facts to keep straight

- Offers include Hermes Desks, Paid Discovery, Care, tutoring, SI automation, dashboards, ecommerce ops, and Stocky dump recovery. Advisory / Fractional CTO is inquire-first.
- Stocky recovery turns an existing Shopify CSV dump into a weekly system using Sheets and ChatGPT or Claude seats the client already pays for. It is not Prediko, Klerio, or another inventory app.
- Hermes is software installed on a Mac the client controls. Windows is available as an extra charge and is quoted separately. ChatGPT and Claude are examples; 300+ models are available. The client pays those bills. Named Desks are on the pricing page.
- Contact: y@gemmisi.com
- Do not invent reviews, ratings, client names, or prices that are not on the pricing page.
